brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed seven Palestinians, including a girl, between November 2 and 5 in a series of airstrikes and shootings across the Gaza Strip, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. Two of the dead had succumbed to injuries from earlier attacks. Several others, including children, were also wounded in the strikes.

The killings occurred as Israeli forces continued operations throughout Gaza. The Centre did not specify which areas were targeted or provide further details on the circumstances of individual deaths.
dek: Between 2 and 5 November 2026, Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed seven Palestinians, including a girl, in a series of airstrikes and shootings targeting various areas across the Gaza Strip. Among those killed were two Palestinians who succumbed to injuries sustained in previous attacks. Several others, including children, were also injured.
title: Israel kills seven Palestinians including girl in Gaza strikes
